_comment: #1046 commission-in-TCE: cargo omits commissionPct → /api/voyage/tce applies founder 3.75% TTL default. commission_usd = round(gross 1960000 * 0.0375) = 73500. net_freight = 1960000 - 73500 = 1886500. net_voyage = net_freight - total_costs 845781 = 1040719. daily_tce = round(1040719 / 34 days) = 30609 (was 32771 gross-of-commission). Not a logic bug — value shifted by commission deduction.
